# Game story fixtures

Copied 2026-11-26 from sportsdataverse-py's `tests/fixtures/game_story/` (released play-by-play of real games; its
README there has the provenance):

- `espn_cfb_pbp_games.parquet`: three 2024 college games (`espn_cfb_pbp` release), projected to the columns the
  football game story reads.
- `espn_nfl_pbp_games.parquet`: three 2024 NFL games and the 2025 GB 40, DAL 40 tie (`espn_nfl_pbp` release).
- `nba_401810169_{pbp,team_box,player_box}.parquet`: one 2025-26 NBA game from the hoopR-nba-data releases.
